ActorTalk: The most distinctive parts of a civilization eventually become memes, spreading to every corner of it.
When did you start talking like a poet?
Just inspired by the Arctic cyborgs. A civilization's ideals seep into its tech and daily life, turning into memes—and that's why each place ends up different.
Differences are great though. More possibilities... even if it means more maintenance headaches.
When ideals drift so far apart that even our machines become incompatible... won't people—and entire civilizations—struggle to connect too, eventually forming divides we can't bridge?
